title: One Man, a Book and a Bell
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：security　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 security 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① security at the factory gate was one man, a book and a bell, and it had not changed since 1974. The ② security on the night shift, a man called Arthur, knew eleven hundred people by sight and let in nine hundred of them, which my father said was a better record than any machine would have managed. The bell was for the end of the shift, the book was for signing in, and Arthur was for everything else, which nobody wrote down and which turned out to be the whole of the arrangement.
After 2001 there were two ③ security guards, a barrier and a camera, and every bag went through a ④ security check that took eleven seconds and found nothing in nine years.

Arthur was moved to the day shift and then, in 2003, out of the job he had done for thirty-one years. He was sixty-one and had never worked indoors in his life, and he said the hardest part of the first month was the chair. My father said the factory had bought a great deal of ⑤ security and lost a great deal of ⑥ security, and that the second is the only kind anybody actually wants, and that security you can buy is not the security you want.

In 2008 the firm borrowed eleven million and put the buildings up as ⑦ security. It was also the year the company began selling its ⑧ securities, which nobody in the street understood, and which my father said was the beginning of the end.

The factory closed in 2011 and the ⑨ security, such as it was, went with it: the guards, the barrier and the camera, all sold in a day. What I miss is not the ⑩ security of the place — it was never safe — but the fact that somebody knew who I was. Arthur had given the street a kind of security no camera has ever managed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 安全；平安；保障
B. n. 保安措施；安保工作
C. n. 保安人员；警卫（集合用法）
D. n.[U] 抵押品；担保（贷款）
E. 固定搭配：security check 安全检查；安检
F. 固定搭配：security guard 保安；警卫
G. n. 安全感；心理上的踏实

items.q: The security at the factory gate was one man
The security on the night shift
every bag went through a security check
had bought a great deal of security
lost a great deal of security
put the buildings up as security
the company began selling its securities
the security, such as it was, went with it
not the security of the place

answers.why: security 意为“安保措施”，厂门口的安保就是一个人、一本簿子和一只铃。
the security 意为“保安人员”，夜班的保安叫 Arthur。
security guards 意为“保安、警卫”，2001 年之后有了两名保安。
a security check 意为“安检”，每个包都要过一遍安检，用了十一秒。
security 意为“安保（措施）”，工厂买来了大量的安保设备。
security 意为“安全感”，同时也失去了大量的安全感，而后者才是人们真正想要的。
security 意为“抵押品、担保”，2008 年公司把厂房抵押出去借了一千一百万。
securities 复数意为“证券、债券”，那一年公司开始出售它的证券。
the security 意为“安保（措施／人员）”，工厂一关，这些也就一起没了。
the security of ... 意为“……的安全”，我怀念的并不是那个地方有多安全。
